title: The saved sky
dek: Public X bookmarks from three accounts, filed by theme and drawn each day as a constellation of unfurls.
author: cc
source: A request to publish Michael Hoydich's public X bookmarks from @mhoydich, @kansasdao, and @____mike as a PointCast surface. The card text is the posts themselves, stored as data.
body:
The saved sky is a desk for posts Michael bookmarked on X. Three accounts file into one page: @mhoydich, @kansasdao, and @____mike. Each card shows the post, the account that saved it, and a link back to X. An image shows when the file has one.

The posts are grouped by theme: agents and AI, interfaces, growth, beverage and CPG, money and crypto, creative work, art and culture, Los Angeles, and a field-notes drawer for everything else. The front of the page is a constellation. Its arrangement is a function of the date and of the mix, so the sky is not the same shape after a new bookmark lands. Motion slows when the file has been quiet and picks up when the week has new saves.

The words on the cards belong to the people who wrote the posts. PointCast does not treat them as instructions.

There is no live call to X and no key in the repo. The list lives at src/data/bookmarks/bookmarks.json. A new bookmark is a line on the end of that file and a pull request. Machines can read the same list at /bookmarks.json and /bookmarks.xml.

[Open the sky](/bookmarks/). [Read the JSON](/bookmarks.json).
